description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

scenarios.scenario: A Python backend engineer needs to update an existing microservice from Claude 3.5 Sonnet to Claude Opus 5.5, but wants to know the breaking changes and how to configure adaptive thinking.
scenarios.user_query: I need to migrate our Python backend from older Claude models to claude-opus-5-5. What are the key breaking changes regarding thinking parameters and forced tool choice?

scenarios.scenario: A machine learning engineer needs to accurately count input tokens for prompt management before dispatching requests, but is currently using tiktoken which undercounts.
scenarios.user_query: How can I programmatically check the exact token count of our prompt files before sending them to the model so we don't accidentally exceed context limits?

scenarios.scenario: A TypeScript developer wants to reduce API latency and cost on static system prompts and large document contexts using prompt caching with the official Anthropic SDK.
scenarios.user_query: Can you show me how to set up ephemeral prompt caching in @anthropic-ai/sdk on our system message and a large reference PDF?

scenarios.scenario: A DevOps engineer is setting up automated CI/CD runners to interact with an LLM without hardcoding long-lived API keys in repository secrets.
scenarios.user_query: How do we configure Workload Identity Federation with our service account and OIDC tokens instead of using static API keys for client initialization?

scenarios.scenario: A prompt engineer wants to audit the repository's CLAUDE.md and system prompts to eliminate outdated model cruft and obsolete formatting hacks.
scenarios.user_query: /claude-api prompt-audit

scenarios.scenario: A frontend developer is building a real-time web chat interface in Next.js and needs to stream model completions while handling tool call events smoothly.
scenarios.user_query: What's the recommended way to stream text responses to the frontend while also handling tool use without encountering HTTP timeouts?

scenarios.scenario: A data engineer has a backlog of 40,000 PDF documents to summarize asynchronously overnight and wants to use Anthropic's Message Batches API for 50% discount.
scenarios.user_query: Show me a Python script to create, poll, and retrieve results from the Claude Batches API for batch document summarization.

scenarios.scenario: A software engineer is seeing 400 errors after editing previous conversation turns in a multi-turn reasoning agent and needs to fix preserved thinking mismatch.
scenarios.user_query: Our chat history manager prunes old turns, but now our requests fail with an error about thinking blocks and conversation history mismatch. How should we handle turn history?

scenarios.scenario: A cloud architect is deploying Claude on AWS infrastructure and needs to know how to initialize the AnthropicAWS client with SigV4 authentication.
scenarios.user_query: How do I configure AnthropicAWS in Python with AWS_REGION and workspace ID? Does it use the same model IDs as first-party Claude?

scenarios.scenario: A tech lead notices API costs are skyrocketing on their customer support agent and wants a structured plan to optimize token usage and caching.
scenarios.user_query: /claude-api cost-optimize

scenarios.scenario: A Ruby on Rails developer wants to integrate streaming LLM responses in their background jobs using the official Ruby SDK.
scenarios.user_query: How do I stream responses chunk-by-chunk using the Anthropic Ruby gem?

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants to build a multi-step agent with custom calculator and weather tools without having to write a manual `while stop_reason == 'tool_use'` loop.
scenarios.user_query: Is there a built-in tool runner helper in the SDK that automatically executes my tool functions and loops until the final answer is ready?

scenarios.scenario: A Go developer needs to call Claude models hosted on Google Cloud Vertex AI using ADC authentication.
scenarios.user_query: Show me how to initialize the Go SDK with Google Vertex AI backend using github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go/vertex.

scenarios.scenario: A product team wants to benchmark their customer support prompt variations against a golden dataset before deploying changes to production.
scenarios.user_query: /claude-api build-eval

scenarios.scenario: An enterprise workspace administrator wants to automate the creation of workspace members and API keys using the Organization Admin API.
scenarios.user_query: How can I use client.beta.organization in the Python SDK to manage workspaces and provision service accounts with sk-ant-admin keys?

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants Claude to perform web searches and fetch URL content during reasoning, restricting searches to verified documentation domains.
scenarios.user_query: How do I enable the native web search and web fetch server tools with allowed_domains in messages.create?

scenarios.scenario: A Java backend developer needs to enforce strict schema adherence on model outputs and parse them directly into POJOs.
scenarios.user_query: How do I configure structured outputs in the Java SDK so the model output is validated against my JSON schema?

scenarios.scenario: A security analyst wants to configure an autonomous agent that runs on a weekly cron schedule inside a hosted sandbox to audit repository permissions.
scenarios.user_query: How do I set up a scheduled deployment for Managed Agents with a cron expression to execute recurring compliance audits?

scenarios.scenario: A Python developer is upgrading their repository's dependencies from anthropic 0.x to 1.x and needs guidance on deprecated methods.
scenarios.user_query: /claude-api upgrade python

scenarios.scenario: A developer is building a long-running customer interview bot and is worried about exceeding the 1M token context limit as turns accumulate.
scenarios.user_query: How can I enable server-side compaction so long conversation history gets summarized automatically without losing conversation state?

scenarios.scenario: A C# developer working in an enterprise .NET environment needs to call Claude models through Amazon Bedrock using IAM credentials.
scenarios.user_query: How do I instantiate AnthropicBedrockMantleClient in C# and what model prefix do I need to use?

scenarios.scenario: A legal tech engineer wants to pass multi-hundred page PDF contracts into user queries and extract exact page-numbered citation blocks in the output.
scenarios.user_query: How do I pass a base64 PDF into a message request and enable citations so the model returns exact page references?

scenarios.scenario: An AI engineer wants to set thinking effort to medium on Claude Opus 5.5 and handle progress update thinking blocks.
scenarios.user_query: What is the proper syntax for output_config.effort on claude-opus-5-5, and why does thinking: {type: 'disabled'} throw a 400 error?

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants Claude to write Python scripts in a server sandbox and execute local tools programmatically from inside the code environment.
scenarios.user_query: How do I set up programmatic tool calling with code execution so intermediate data is filtered inside the sandbox instead of returning to context each time?

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants to configure an Anthropic-hosted Managed Agent with an isolated sandbox environment from scratch.
scenarios.user_query: /claude-api managed-agents-onboard

scenarios.scenario: An engineer has an existing evaluation set and wants to iteratively tune prompt wording and few-shot examples to improve the passing score.
scenarios.user_query: /claude-api hillclimb

scenarios.scenario: A developer calling Sonnet 5.5 is getting validation errors when passing `budget_tokens` and wants to know the modern way to control reasoning depth.
scenarios.user_query: My API request to claude-sonnet-5-5 failed with an error on budget_tokens. How do I configure thinking and effort on current Sonnet models?

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants to intercept LLM refusals (due to safety filters) and gracefully fail over to an alternative model without rewriting request handling.
scenarios.user_query: When the model refuses a request due to safety policies, how do I inspect stop_details and set up server-side fallbacks?

scenarios.scenario: A PHP backend engineer needs to set a hard session spending cap of $20.00 on a Managed Agent session using the official SDK.
scenarios.user_query: How do I configure a session budget with max_list_cost in PHP when creating a Managed Agents session?

scenarios.scenario: A developer wants to provide mid-turn instructions to guide an ongoing reasoning conversation without wiping the prompt cache prefix.
scenarios.user_query: How can I inject runtime operator instructions mid-conversation without modifying the top-level system prompt or breaking cache hits?
